# Vydrop

Vydrop (formerly ViFree and YouTube Downloader) is a free MIT-licensed Windows 10/11 x64 video and audio downloader by Ziad Hassanein. Stable version: 4.4.8. It uses yt-dlp for public media from 1,000+ supported sites, including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, X/Twitter, Reddit, Dailymotion and Twitch clips, plus direct media links. Outputs include MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV and FLAC. Features include playlists, queue, available SRT/VTT captions, an optional Chrome/Edge/Firefox companion, English and Arabic, and automatic missing-tool preparation. Private, sign-in-only and DRM media are unsupported. Quality depends on the source; site support can change. No account, API key, subscription or telemetry. Local settings/history/tools use the legacy YouTubeDownloader app-data folder.

## Language and region guides
The app UI is English/Arabic. Website guides additionally cover US English, French, German and Spanish. Arabic regional wording covers 22 countries without changing product capabilities.
- [US English](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/en-us/)
- [French](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/fr/)
- [German](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/de/)
- [Spanish](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/es/)
- [Arabic regional terminology](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/ar/arabic-regional-guide.html)

The repository is now Vydrop; installed versions through 4.2.1 require one manual download after the rename; 4.4.8 uses the current update endpoint. A listed site or visible browser tab does not guarantee a downloadable public stream. These facts describe supported scope, not per-site testing or a ranking guarantee.
